sn43.2:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the unconditioned and the path leading to the unconditioned.
sn43.2:1.4: The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion:
sn43.2:1.6: “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.2:1.8: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
